note: Independent semantic rejudgment 2026-11-12 against all CoA atomicity and unsuccessful Disconnect clauses in Section 2.3. Existing ChangeThatCannotBeCarriedOutIsNAKed and CoANAKMakesNoPartialChange cover unavailable dispatch/no access interface on L2TP; SubscriberCoAThatCannotBeCarriedOutWholeMakesNoChange covers the subscriber path, requiring 506 and no change notification. RequestWhoseEveryValueIsSupportedIsACKed retains all requested control notifications. New MixedOwnerFailureRestoresBothControls drives real registered shaper and CoS owners through signed UDP, makes VLAN application partially write after rate application, then requires CoA-NAK 506 with original 10M/5M shaping and both original empty VLAN maps. MixedOwnersApplyBeforeACK supplies the same valid request without backend failure and requires signed ACK only with actual 20M/8M shaping plus both gold maps installed. Thus an ACK after mere notification, incomplete application or failure without reverse compensation fails actual state assertions. DisconnectThatCannotTerminateIsNAKed requires NAK after the failed single teardown; DisconnectThatTerminatesIsACKed requires ACK and one completed teardown. This NAS refuses multiple matches before any mutation, so the unsupported-multiple-session route cannot partially terminate or update a set. confirmCoA prepares all bounded owners, applies/commits synchronously and rolls back in reverse on failure. Native new-pair records are not asserted by this source judgement.
